quarterly_data.quarter: AQT press release: New 47.5 million Euro European Commission grant supports (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The European Commission is providing Euro 47.5 million to the Quantum Internet Alliance (QIA, led by TU Delft) for its next phase (Specific Grant Agreement SGA 2, 42 months of R&D) to build a full-stack, programmable quantum internet prototype - trapped-ion quantum internet nodes in two metropolitan-scale networks linked by hundreds of kilometres of fibre via quantum repeaters; the University of Innsbruck and AQT will receive Euro 5.4 million of it, with AQT contributing trapped-ion hardware as a partner.
quarterly_data.figure: Euro 5.4 million to the University of Innsbruck and AQT (of a Euro 47.5 million grant); 42 months
